name: SJS Enterprises Ltd
tagline: Small-cap decorative-aesthetics auto-ancillary; Q1 FY27 came in strong (record Rs 261 Cr revenue, EBITDA margin +239bps to 30%, normalised PAT +45%) which materially de-risks an Aug-2026 trusted caution on standalone stagnation, but the stock is ~35x P/E near an all-time high and the cover-glass/display TAM story is still a FY27-28 forward bet
business_overview: SJS Enterprises manufactures decorative aesthetic products for automotive and consumer appliance industries — dials, overlays, badges, cover glass, and (via its Exotech/WPI plants) chrome-plated and injection-moulded trim components. It has diversified into digital cockpit displays via a Technology License Agreement with BOE Varitronix (Hong Kong), onboarded Dixon as a customer for the consumer-durables segment, and is scaling exports (currently 6.7% of revenue, targeting 14-15% by FY28) with wins from Stellantis, Whirlpool, Autoliv and Hero Motocorp.

fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely strong quality (ROE 17.4%, ROCE 21.89%, near-zero debt) with revenue compounding ~17-18% and FY26 consol revenue +25.6% / PAT +44.6%. Q1 FY27 was the strongest quarter since listing: record Rs 261 Cr revenue (+24.5% YoY), EBITDA margin +239bps to 30.0% on richer mix and higher exports, normalised PAT +45% (headline PAT +115% flattered by a Rs 24.17 Cr one-time exceptional gain). PV segment +45.4% and exports +83.2% YoY drove the quarter; 27th consecutive quarter of outperforming the auto industry. Management guides to 1.5-2x industry growth in FY27 with >88% of the year's revenue already in the order book, and exports to 14-15% of revenue by FY28. The Aug-2026 trusted caution (standalone stagnation for four quarters, growth concentrated in the Decoplast subsidiary, H2 margin pressure from a post-GST base and new Pune plant costs) is partly answered by the strong consolidated Q1 print but the standalone-vs-subsidiary mix and the H2 base effect are not yet fully cleared. Cover-glass / digital-cockpit-display remains a FY27-28 forward bet: a wholly owned subsidiary has been approved and a Hosur optical-cover-glass + display-assembly facility is being set up, with first cover-glass revenue targeted in FY27.

verdict_headline: Well-diligenced small-cap compounder whose strong Q1 FY27 print largely answers the Aug-2026 trusted caution, but valuation is rich (~35x, near ATH) and the cover-glass/display leg is still forward-looking
verdict_reasoning: Fundamentals are independently strong (ROE 17.4%, ROCE 21.89%, near debt-free) and the trusted signal history is real and sized (joinjp2003 ramped to 8% of portfolio; named a 2025 conviction bet).

Q1 FY27 was the best quarter since listing - record Rs 261 Cr revenue (+24.5%), EBITDA margin +239bps to 30.0%, normalised PAT +45%, PV +45%, exports +83% - which directly rebuts the 'growth is only Decoplast' framing of the Aug-2026 trusted caution; the standalone-vs-subsidiary split and the H2 post-GST base effect are still open but the near-term picture has improved, not worsened.

four_box score is 2.5 (valuation box = no at ~35x near an all-time high). Exception invoked per the decision table: a credible, now-under-construction catalyst (Hosur cover-glass facility, dedicated WOS, BOE Varitronix display license, first revenue targeted FY27) plus consistent 20-25% compounding and 27 straight quarters of industry outperformance is un-ignorable for a small-cap - thesis_fit '10x-in-2-3-years' retained, conviction capped at Medium.

Conviction raised Low -> Low-Medium: the freshest hard data (Q1 FY27) is now supportive rather than cautionary, but the rich multiple and the fact that cover-glass/display revenue is still a FY27-28 bet keep it below Medium. Revisit after Q2 FY27 for margin durability and standalone-growth disclosure.
No red flags; promoter pledge from Dec 2024 was fully released by Q1 FY26; no SEBI/auditor issues.

four_box.note: tailwind yes (auto premiumisation + content-per-vehicle rising + cover-glass/display TAM cited 3-4x over 5yrs + export scaling). tam weak (Rs 7,800 Cr mcap on ~Rs 1,000 Cr revenue; a literal 10x needs the cover-glass/display optionality to become a large second business - possible but unproven). moat yes (per-programme aesthetic design + tooling lock-in, 27 consecutive quarters of industry outperformance, BOE Varitronix license). valuation no (~35.5x P/E near an all-time high; core premiumisation largely priced). score 2.5 -> exception written in verdict_reasoning (credible dated catalyst + consistent 20-25% compounding for a small-cap) keeps thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years, conviction capped per the decision table.
